topic.name: 交流电与LC振荡实验
topic.title: 电流换方向时，灯泡与线圈怎样响应？
topic.question: 电流换方向时，灯泡与线圈怎样响应？
topic.description: 用示波器、反并联LED、交流元件和LC回路逐步比较变化的电流。

translations.电流换方向时，灯泡与线圈怎样响应？: How do lamps and coils respond when current reverses?
translations.用示波器、反并联LED、交流元件和LC回路逐步比较变化的电流。: Compare changing current through oscilloscopes, antiparallel LEDs, reactive components and an LC loop.
translations.线圈与交流灯泡: A coil and an AC lamp
translations.电容与交流灯泡: A capacitor and an AC lamp
translations.电源、元件和测量电路与同一波形同步: Source, components and measurement circuit share the same waveform
translations.滑环保持两端独立连接: Slip rings keep the two terminals connected separately
translations.充电结束后，电流趋于零: Current tends to zero after charging
translations.切至线圈，电源退出振荡: Switch to the coil; the source leaves the loop
translations.有正负刻度的电压波形: Voltage waveform with positive and negative values
translations.交流与直流比较使用相同3伏有效值。灯泡是固定6欧电阻，交流亮度采用平均功率；感抗: AC/DC comparisons use the same three-volt RMS supply. Lamps are fixed six-ohm resistors with average AC power. The coil includes two-ohm winding resistance; capacitor DC mode shows its charging transient. LEDs use a 1.8-volt threshold and 100-ohm limiter; slip rings do not rectify. LC uses 0.2 H, 1000 μF and adjustable series loss, solved analytically. Views are slow-motion model traces, not sampled measurements.
translations.周期性跨过零，意味着电压极性反转。: Crossing zero periodically reverses voltage polarity.
translations.一个方向的电流点亮一只LED。: One current direction lights one LED.
translations.电流反向，另一只LED发光。: Reversed current lights the other LED.
translations.变化电流带来感抗，灯泡变暗。: Inductive reactance makes the lamp dimmer.
translations.短暂充电以后，电流趋于零。: A brief charging current tends to zero.
translations.外电路持续有电流，电子不穿过介质。: External current continues without electrons crossing the dielectric.
translations.电容不变，频率越高，容抗越小。: At fixed capacitance, higher frequency lowers reactance.
translations.开关先接电源，建立初始电场能。: The switch first stores electric energy in the capacitor.
translations.电阻耗散使振幅和电磁能逐渐减小。: Resistive loss reduces amplitude and field energy.

cues.title: 先观察电池
cues.caption: 直流电压保持同一极性。
cues.zh: 把示波器接在电池两端，观察电压随时间的记录。曲线停留在零线上方，表示这个理想电池的电压保持同一极性和大小。注意波形的纵轴，不要只把它看成一条线。
cues.en: Connect the oscilloscope across a battery. Its trace stays above zero, representing a constant voltage with one polarity. Read the vertical axis: the line records a physical quantity over time.

cues.title: 换成交流电源
cues.caption: 周期性跨过零，意味着电压极性反转。
cues.captionEn: Crossing zero periodically reverses voltage polarity.
cues.zh: 换接学生电源的交流输出。电压周期性跨过零，上下两部分分别代表相反的极性。这里交流有效值仍是三伏，但峰值更大。有效值相同，不等于每一瞬间的电压相同。
cues.en: Switch to the teaching supply’s AC output. Voltage crosses zero periodically, so the two halves represent opposite polarities. Its RMS value is still three volts, while its peak is larger. Equal RMS values do not imply equal instantaneous voltages.

cues.title: 发电机的一半周期
cues.caption: 一个方向的电流点亮一只LED。
cues.captionEn: One current direction lights one LED.
cues.zh: 转动教学发电机，跟随磁极之间的线圈。滑环使两个线圈端点各自保持连接。两个LED反向并联，电流朝一个方向时只有对应的LED导通并发光。
cues.en: Turn the teaching generator and follow its coil between the poles. Separate slip rings preserve contact with both winding ends. The LEDs are antiparallel: a given current direction lights only the appropriately oriented LED.

cues.title: 另一半周期
cues.caption: 电流反向，另一只LED发光。
cues.captionEn: Reversed current lights the other LED.
cues.zh: 继续转动，线圈中感应电动势反向，另一只LED亮起。对照电流读数的正负号，两个发光方向与同一转子相位对应。滑环只是保持连接，并没有把交流变成直流。
cues.en: Continue turning. The induced emf reverses and the other LED lights. Compare the signed current readout with the shared rotor phase. Slip rings maintain electrical contact; they do not turn this AC output into DC.

cues.title: 线圈接直流
cues.caption: 稳态直流由电阻限制。
cues.zh: 将灯泡与带电阻的线圈串联，接三伏直流电源。等待接通暂态结束，电流不再变化，线圈的自感电动势归零。此时限制电流的是灯泡与绕组的总电阻。
cues.en: Connect the lamp and resistive coil in series to three-volt DC. After the switching transient, current stops changing and the self-induced emf is zero. Lamp and winding resistances now determine current.

cues.title: 保持有效值，改接交流
cues.caption: 变化电流带来感抗，灯泡变暗。
cues.captionEn: Inductive reactance makes the lamp dimmer.
cues.zh: 保持电源有效值相同，改接交流。电流不断变化，线圈的感抗进一步限制电流，灯泡平均功率减小。提高频率或增加自感系数，感抗还会增大。
cues.en: Keep source RMS voltage unchanged and switch to AC. Continuously changing current introduces inductive reactance, reducing lamp power. Raising frequency or inductance increases that reactance.

cues.title: 直流充电暂态
cues.caption: 短暂充电以后，电流趋于零。
cues.captionEn: A brief charging current tends to zero.
cues.zh: 把串联元件换成电容。刚接直流时电容充电，电流逐渐减小；充电结束，电流趋于零。因此直流不通过电容说的是稳态，不能抹掉刚接通时的充电过程。
cues.en: Replace the series component with a capacitor. On connection to DC, it charges and current decays toward zero. Blocking DC describes the steady state; it does not erase the initial charging transient.

cues.title: 交流反复充放电
cues.caption: 外电路持续有电流，电子不穿过介质。
cues.captionEn: External current continues without electrons crossing the dielectric.
cues.zh: 改接交流后，电容反复充电与放电，外电路持续有变化的电流，灯泡可以发光。极板间的绝缘介质没有因此变成导线。相同有效值下，容抗仍会限制电流。
cues.en: On AC, repeated charging and discharging sustains changing current in the external circuit, allowing the lamp to glow. The dielectric does not become a conducting wire. Capacitive reactance still limits current at the same RMS voltage.

cues.title: 提高交流频率
cues.caption: 电容不变，频率越高，容抗越小。
cues.captionEn: At fixed capacitance, higher frequency lowers reactance.
cues.zh: 保持同一个电容和相同电源有效值，把频率提高。容抗降低，电流有效值和灯泡平均功率增加。这个趋势与线圈的感抗正好相反，不能把所有元件都当作固定电阻。
cues.en: Keep capacitance and source RMS voltage fixed, then raise frequency. Capacitive reactance falls, increasing RMS current and average lamp power. The trend is opposite to inductive reactance; reactive components are not fixed resistors.

cues.title: 先给电容充电
cues.caption: 开关先接电源，建立初始电场能。
cues.captionEn: The switch first stores electric energy in the capacitor.
cues.zh: 把单刀双掷开关接向电源，让电容充到五伏。此时线圈不在充电回路中，能量主要储存在电容电场里。电压传感器始终接在两极板之间，准备记录接下来的变化。
cues.en: Set the changeover switch toward the source and charge the capacitor to five volts. The coil is outside this charging circuit. Initial energy is stored in the capacitor’s electric field, while the sensor remains connected across its plates.

cues.title: 切换到线圈
cues.caption: 电场能与磁场能交替交换。
cues.zh: 把开关切向线圈，电源退出。电容放电，线圈电流增加；电容电压经过零时，电流并不立刻停止，而是继续给电容反向充电。传感器记录出跨越正负的振荡。
cues.en: Switch onto the coil, removing the source. Capacitor discharge builds coil current. When capacitor voltage crosses zero, current continues and charges it with opposite polarity. The sensor records the alternating voltage.

cues.title: 真实振荡会衰减
cues.caption: 电阻耗散使振幅和电磁能逐渐减小。
cues.captionEn: Resistive loss reduces amplitude and field energy.
cues.zh: 把观察时间拉长。回路电阻不断把部分电磁能变成热，电压峰值逐渐减小。自由探索中把损耗降为零，可以得到理想的持续振荡；那是有明确条件的模型极限。
cues.en: Extend the observation. Circuit resistance converts some electromagnetic energy into heat each cycle, reducing voltage peaks. In exploration, zero resistance gives ideal sustained oscillation—a model limit with an explicit condition.
